concepts.def: November 2013 Category 5 storm hit the central Philippines (LIC/NEE).
Over 6,300 people killed and around 4 million displaced.
October 2012 storm hit New Jersey and New York (HIC).
Around 233 deaths in total, with major economic damage.
Wealthier countries have better warning systems and recovery.
Warmer seas may make the strongest storms more intense. 🌧

walkthroughs.body_html:
Typhoon Haiyan hit the Philippines on 8 November 2013.

Sustained winds of about 315 km/h and a 5 m surge at Tacloban.

Over 6,300 people lost their lives.

Hurricane Sandy hit the US east coast in October 2012.

It killed about 233 people overall but caused $70 billion of damage.

NYC's subway flooded and millions lost power.

Comparison shows the role of development.

The US had stronger forecasting, evacuation and insurance.

The Philippines suffered far more deaths despite a similar storm.
